02-1.concept:
flowchart LR
    SYS["system prompt: role, rules, constraints"] --> CONV["conversation"]
    USER["user message: per-turn request"] --> CONV
    CONV --> MODEL["model call"]
    SYS -.->|"higher priority, may be a separate field"| MODEL

02-2.concept:
flowchart LR
    TASK["task"] --> Z["zero-shot: instruction only"]
    TASK --> F["few-shot: a few worked examples"]
    TASK --> C["chain-of-thought: reason step by step"]
    Z --> OUT["output"]
    F --> OUT
    C --> OUT

02-3.concept:
flowchart TD
    REQ["want structured output"] --> CONSTRAIN["constrain generation: JSON schema / tool mode"]
    CONSTRAIN --> GEN["model generates"]
    GEN --> VALID{"valid against schema?"}
    VALID -->|yes| OK["use the object"]
    VALID -->|no| RETRY["return error → model retries"]

02-4.concept:
flowchart LR
    P["prompt version"] --> VCS["source control / prompt store"]
    VCS --> ID["immutable id / content hash"]
    ID --> DEPLOY["activate or roll back without redeploying"]
    DEPLOY --> LOG["log version with model + params + outputs"]

10-9.concept:
flowchart LR
    DOCS["corpus"] --> EMB["embedding model"]
    Q["query"] --> EMB
    EMB --> VEC["vectors in one shared space"]
    VEC --> SIM["similarity search"]
    NOTE["bigger is not automatically better — match domain + language, measure recall"] -.-> EMB

10-10.concept:
flowchart LR
    DOCS["documents"] --> E1["embed_documents (passages)"]
    Q["query"] --> E2["embed_query (query)"]
    E1 --> SS["same embedding space"]
    E2 --> SS
    SS --> OK["comparable vectors → meaningful similarity"]

11-1.concept:
flowchart LR
    Q["query"] --> D["dense: embeddings, top-k"]
    Q --> S["sparse: BM25 / keyword, top-k"]
    D --> F["fuse"]
    S --> F
    F --> RRF["rank fusion: score = sum of 1/(k + rank)"]
    RRF --> TOP["fused top-k"]

11-2.concept:
flowchart TD
    Q["query with exact terms (codes, IDs, names)"] --> DENSE["dense/semantic: may miss the exact match"]
    Q --> SPARSE["sparse/BM25: matches the literal term"]
    DENSE --> DOWN["a wrong chunk can outrank the exact hit"]
    SPARSE --> UP["the exact hit ranks high"]
    DOWN --> HYB["use hybrid: dense + sparse"]
    UP --> HYB

13-3.concept:
flowchart TD
    Q["query"] --> RET["retrieve"]
    RET --> GEN["generate from context"]
    GEN --> G{"grounded in the context?"}
    G -->|"no explicit gate"| HALL["hallucination risk"]
    HALL --> FIX["verify + abstain when the context does not answer"]

13-5.concept:
flowchart TD
    SAME["same question"] --> A1["answer A"]
    SAME --> A2["answer B (another day)"]
    A1 --> CAUSE["causes: sampling temperature, reranking, embedding drift"]
    A2 --> CAUSE
    CAUSE --> FIX["pin temperature = 0, use a seed, fingerprint the embedding model"]

13-7.concept:
flowchart LR
    Q["query"] --> R["retrieve"]
    R -->|"empty"| FB["fallback: sparse"]
    R -->|"throws"| ERR["surface a clear error"]
    FB --> RK["rerank"]
    RK -->|"fails"| ERR2["abort — do not silently return pre-rerank order"]
    RK --> GEN["generate"]
    GEN -->|"fails"| RETRY["retry/backoff, then raise"]

14-7.concept:
flowchart TD
    NEED["requirements"] --> SCALE["scale + latency"]
    NEED --> FEAT["hybrid search + metadata filters"]
    NEED --> OPS["managed vs self-hosted · cost · data residency"]
    SCALE --> CHOICE["Chroma (local) · Milvus (server) · pgvector (relational)"]
    FEAT --> CHOICE
    OPS --> CHOICE

12-7.concept:
flowchart TD
    Q["question"] --> R["retrieve"]
    R --> E{"enough to answer?"}
    E -->|no| R2["reformulate + retrieve again"]
    R2 --> CAP{"hop budget reached?"}
    CAP -->|no| R
    CAP -->|yes| STOP["stop and answer with what we have"]
    E -->|yes| ANS["answer"]

08-1.concept:
flowchart LR
    RAW["raw API calls"] --> BUILD["you build: loop · retries · state · tools · streaming"]
    FW["agent framework"] --> GIVE["gives you: loop + tool plumbing + state + rails"]
    GIVE --> FOCUS["you focus on the task"]

08-4.concept:
flowchart TD
    DEC{"heavier framework vs custom?"} --> HEAVY["framework: faster start · more features · more abstraction"]
    DEC --> LIGHT["custom: full control · less magic · more work"]
    HEAVY --> TIE["decide on: team size · rate of change · need for control"]
    LIGHT --> TIE

08-5.concept:
flowchart TD
    USE["framework feature"] --> Q{"does it solve a real problem?"}
    Q -->|no| OVER["over-abstraction: hides control, adds debugging cost"]
    Q -->|yes| OK["keep it"]

08-6.concept:
flowchart TD
    BIZ["business logic"] --> MIS{"framework abstraction fits?"}
    MIS -->|no| ESC["escape hatch: custom tool · lower-level API · fork"]
    MIS -->|yes| OK["use as-is"]

08-7.concept:
flowchart TD
    DONE["node finishes"] --> ROUTE{"router / conditional edge"}
    ROUTE -->|A| NA["node A"]
    ROUTE -->|B| NB["node B"]
    NA --> CH["update shared state"]
    NB --> CH
    CH --> NEXT["next ready node"]

10-17.concept:
flowchart TD
    Q["question"] --> A["agent decides: retrieve? which query? enough?"]
    A --> R["retrieve"]
    R --> A
    A -->|enough| ANS["answer"]
    FIXED["fixed RAG: retrieve once, then generate"] -.->|"no decisions"| ANS2["answer"]

08-9.concept:
flowchart TD
    FW["framework choice"] --> TEAM{"fits the team + change rate?"}
    TEAM -->|small team, few devs| LIGHT["lighter, less magic"]
    TEAM -->|large team, many features| STRUCT["more structure / abstraction"]
    LIGHT --> OK["scales with the team"]
    STRUCT --> OK

03-20.concept:
flowchart TD
    INJ["prompt injection"] --> WHY["untrusted content carries instructions"]
    WHY --> RISK["model may act on them"]
    RISK --> DEF["treat as data + enforce controls outside the model"]

05-4.concept:
flowchart TD
    subgraph L["linear chain"]
    A["step 1"] --> B["step 2"] --> C["step 3"]
    end
    subgraph G["graph with conditional branches"]
    S["start"] --> D{"condition?"}
    D -->|"yes"| Y["branch A"]
    D -->|"no"| N["branch B"]
    Y --> E["join"]
    N --> E
    end

05-5.concept:
flowchart TD
    I(["input"]) --> R["Reason: model call"]
    R --> D{"tool calls?"}
    D -->|yes| TA["Act: run tools"] --> OB["Observe: tool result"] --> R
    D -->|"no tool calls"| O(["answer"])

05-6.concept:
flowchart TD
    subgraph PLAN["Plan everything upfront"]
    I1(["input"]) --> P["plan all steps"] --> S1["step 1"] --> S2["step 2"] --> O1(["answer"])
    end
    subgraph LOOP["ReAct loop"]
    direction TB
        I2(["input"]) --> R["Reason: model call"]
        R --> D{"tool calls?"}
        D -->|yes| TA["Act: run tools"] --> OB["Observe: tool result"] --> R
    end
    D -->|"no tool calls"| O2(["answer"])

06-3.concept:
flowchart LR
    TOOL["tool function + schema"] --> REG["register with the agent/framework"]
    REG --> LIST["expose tool definitions"]
    LIST --> MODEL["provider tool-use API"]
    MODEL --> CALL["model emits a tool call"]

06-4.concept:
flowchart TD
    RAW["model tool-call arguments (string)"] --> PARSE{"valid JSON?"}
    PARSE -->|no| REPAIR["repair brackets / quotes"]
    PARSE -->|yes| SCHEMA
    REPAIR -->|"still broken"| ERR["readable error → back to model"]
    REPAIR --> SCHEMA["validate against the tool's schema"]
    SCHEMA -->|valid| RUN["run function (defaults filled)"]
    SCHEMA -->|invalid| ERR

06-5.concept:
flowchart TD
    NEED["capability not built in"] --> WRAP["wrap it as a custom tool (function / MCP)"]
    WRAP --> SCHEMA["describe input schema + docstring"]
    SCHEMA --> REG["register"]
    REG --> MODEL["model can now call it"]

06-7.concept:
flowchart TD
    STEP["run step"] --> E{"timeout or error?"}
    E -->|transient| RETRY["retry with backoff"]
    E -->|permanent| FAIL["surface a clear error"]
    E -->|none| NEXT["next step"]

06-8.concept:
flowchart TD
    CALL["tool call fails"] --> ID{"idempotent?"}
    ID -->|yes| RETRY["retry with backoff"]
    ID -->|no| GUARD["don't blind-retry: dedupe key · confirm · make it idempotent"]
    RETRY --> OK["success"]
    GUARD --> OK

07-6.concept:
flowchart LR
    S1["step 1"] --> STATE["shared state (messages · plan · todos · memory)"]
    STATE --> S2["step 2"]
    S2 --> STATE
    STATE --> S3["next step sees prior results"]

09-7.concept:
flowchart TD
    FAIL["bad final result"] --> TRACE["follow the handoff trace (who produced what)"]
    TRACE --> FIND["locate the failing agent / step"]
    FIND --> FIX["fix that step; re-run from there"]

15-20.concept:
flowchart LR
    TRAFFIC["live traffic"] --> SAMPLE["sample + log"]
    SAMPLE --> METRICS["quality metrics (groundedness · relevance · task success)"]
    METRICS --> ALERT{"regression?"}
    ALERT -->|yes| ROLLBACK["alert / roll back"]
    ALERT -->|no| MONITOR["keep monitoring"]

16-3.concept:
flowchart TD
    SCALE["usage scales unpredictably"] --> LEVERS["levers"]
    LEVERS --> SMALL["route simple queries to smaller models"]
    LEVERS --> CACHE["cache repeated / similar queries"]
    LEVERS --> BUDGET["per-user / session budgets + caps"]
    LEVERS --> BATCH["batch work, reduce top-k"]

16-5.concept:
flowchart TD
    TOOLS["agent calls tools repeatedly"] --> CAPS["cap iterations + token/step budget"]
    TOOLS --> CACHE["cache / dedup identical calls"]
    TOOLS --> ROUTE["route simple calls to a cheaper model"]
    CAPS --> SAVE["bounded cost"]
    CACHE --> SAVE
    ROUTE --> SAVE

16-7.concept:
flowchart LR
    Q["query"] --> HIT{"exact or semantic match in cache?"}
    HIT -->|yes| RETURN["return cached answer (no model call)"]
    HIT -->|no| GEN["generate, then store under a key"]
    GEN --> STORE["cache (normalized query / embedding)"]

18-1.concept:
flowchart TD
    SRC["untrusted text: tool output · retrieved doc · user"] --> ATTACK["hidden instructions"]
    ATTACK --> MODEL["model may follow them"]
    DEF["defenses: treat as data · delimit · enforce outside the model"] --> SAFE["safe behavior"]
    ATTACK -.->|mitigated by| DEF

18-3.concept:
flowchart LR
    U["tool result / retrieved doc"] --> WRAP["wrap + label as untrusted data"]
    WRAP --> MODEL["model reads it as data, not instructions"]
    MODEL --> GUARD["actions gated by permissions outside the model"]

18-4.concept:
flowchart TD
    U["user tries to bypass guardrails"] --> DEF["defense in depth"]
    DEF --> POLICY["policy / safety prompt"]
    DEF --> CLASS["input / output classifiers"]
    DEF --> ENFORCE["enforce privileged actions outside the model"]

18-7.concept:
flowchart LR
    GEN["model output"] --> CHECK["safety checks (policy · classifier)"]
    CHECK -->|unsafe| BLOCK["block / rewrite / safe fallback"]
    CHECK -->|ok| RETURN["return"]

18-11.concept:
flowchart LR
    Q["seemingly normal question (tool output, retrieved doc)"] --> REAL["really testing: prompt-injection awareness"]
    REAL --> ANSWER["treat tool / retrieved content as untrusted data"]

18-12.concept:
flowchart TD
    IN["question about untrusted input"] --> REAL["tests prompt-injection awareness"]
    REAL --> GOOD["treat as data · sanitize · enforce outside the model"]

01-1.concept:
flowchart LR
    TEXT["raw text"] --> TOK["tokenizer (BPE / unigram)"]
    TOK --> ONE["common word = 1 token"]
    TOK --> MANY["rare / long word, code, non-English = many tokens"]
    ONE --> COST["cost & context counted in TOKENS"]
    MANY --> COST

01-2.concept:
flowchart LR
    F["text"] --> N["fragmentation → # tokens"]
    N --> C["cost per request"]
    N --> W["context window fills faster"]
    N --> K["chunk / compaction thresholds"]
01-2.technical:
flowchart LR
    N["token count (TokenCounter)"] --> CB["context budget = DEFAULT_CONTEXT_MAX_TOKENS"]
    N --> OF["tool-result offload budget (per round)"]
    N --> CO["cost: usage_metadata input/output/cache tokens"]
    N --> CH["chunk size / retrieval chunking"]

01-6.concept:
flowchart LR
    IN["input text"] --> ENC["encoder (bidirectional)"]
    ENC --> UND["understanding: classify · embed · extract"]
    PRE["prompt"] --> DEC["decoder (autoregressive)"]
    DEC --> GEN["generation: next token"]
    ENC --> ED["encoder-decoder: input → output (translate · summarize)"]

01-9.concept:
flowchart TD
    IN["conversation exceeds the context window"] --> PRE{"shrink before sending"}
    PRE --> DROP["drop oldest turns, keep recent"]
    PRE --> OFF["offload large tool outputs"]
    PRE --> SUM["summarize old turns into memory"]
    DROP --> SEND["send smaller prompt"]
    OFF --> SEND
    SUM --> SEND
    SEND -->|still too long| ERR["provider rejects → force compaction & retry"]

01-10.concept:
flowchart TD
    LONG["long context that fits the window"] --> DIL["attention diluted across more tokens"]
    LONG --> MID["middle of context used poorly (lost in the middle)"]
    LONG --> DIS["distractors can override instructions"]
    DIL --> HARM["worse answers even though it fits"]
    MID --> HARM
    DIS --> HARM
    HARM --> FIX["retrieve less · rerank · put key info at the ends"]
